title: Kimi Assistant for Support
excerpt: A quick overview of how we wired Kimi to help with support questions.
content: The Support page now includes a Kimi-powered assistant. It reuses our Nitro /kimi endpoint, keeps data on-platform, and avoids new dependencies.
